About The Job

The client is hiring for this role, and Harper, an AI career agent, is on your side of the table. Skip the application form: just talk to Harper, and in a few minutes it learns your background, then puts the strongest profiles directly in front of the client's decision-makers. 👉 Start with Harper

Job Title

Project Manager, Enterprise GPU Cluster Projects (Seoul)

Level

5+ years running complex customer projects in cloud infrastructure, SI/MSP, network or storage vendors, or technical professional services. You will be the first Project Manager on the Korea go-to-market team.

Salary

Competitive, negotiated based on experience

Location

Seoul, South Korea (On-site, flexible start times 8–11am)

Company Description

A Seoul-and-San-Francisco GPU cloud startup that gives AI teams the GPU compute they need, when they need it, by connecting capacity from multiple cloud and data center partners into one cloud. Founded in 2020, it has raised about $17M and serves 100+ customers, including a top automaker's autonomous-driving team, academic and frontier labs, and large public-sector AI programs. Revenue grew 3.4x year over year.

What You'll Do

Own enterprise GPU cluster projects end to end: deal readiness, contract, build-out, acceptance, go-live and handoff
Run fit/gap analysis of customer RFIs against delivery scope, supply-contract volumes, timelines and SLAs before close
Discuss workloads and cluster design (compute, network, storage) with customer engineers and propose configurations
Catch schedule, supply, technical and security risks early, and bring non-standard asks to leadership with their cost and timeline impact
Run project reviews with customer executives, cloud and data center partners, telcos, MSPs and internal teams
Build the delivery playbook: RFI template, deal readiness review, go-live checklist and acceptance criteria

Who You Are

5+ years leading customer-facing projects in cloud infrastructure, SI/MSP, network or storage vendors, or technical professional services
Led projects A to Z, from requirements to build-out, acceptance and handoff
Understand GPU servers, high-performance networking, storage and Kubernetes or Slurm well enough to discuss trade-offs
Managed scope, schedule and risk across customers, supply partners and several internal teams, tied to SOW and SLA
Explain status and risk clearly to customer executives, engineers and leadership

Why Join

Lead GPU cluster projects of hundreds to thousands of GPUs, and see the whole AI infrastructure business from supply to customer workloads
Design the delivery system as the first Project Manager on the Korea team, working directly with customer executives and the C-level
Annual US market trip, self-development budget and flexible hours

How This Works

Harper is an AI career agent on your side, free for candidates and paid by companies only when someone gets hired.

Talk to Harper for a few minutes about your background and what you want next
Harper checks the fit and introduces you directly to the hiring team
You hear back with next steps, and Harper keeps you posted

Why the company is unnamed: our clients ask us not to name them publicly. You'll get the name as soon as you connect.
